intent: Course exploration overview: display all previously reported candidates and descriptive partial-pattern matches; preserve actual provenance and numerical values.
real_traditional: Join all540 run-level MEME/STREME candidates to case metadata, discovery/development FIMO summary and development cluster statistics; retain all candidates and native p/q, original main17 flags, and closest available descriptive reference, no filtering by significance or performance.
real_embedding: Join all1289 run-level candidate/control records from 53 previously completed runs; retain all natural and shuffle results separately, source-specific p and both q columns when present; STREME rows are repeated comparators and not new independent motifs.

partial_alignment.selection: maximum reference cosine within each existing frozen candidate view; no cutoff; an empty view stays zero
partial_alignment.coordinate: project full reference start from PWM scan start using the offset and scan strand
partial_alignment.score: reference-assisted localization F1 includes calls on planted and blank test sequences; family blank FPR counts any candidate irrespective of reference similarity

analysis_status: post-hoc exploratory re-evaluation of already-observed Development/Test, not new blinded validation; reference used to select the matching candidate solely for synthetic evaluation; no biological function, motif novelty or significance implied by partial similarity
data_policy: read existing evidence and local synthetic artifacts only; no model retraining, no real sequence generation or rescans, no new Holdout access; no change to previous reports, data, or outputs
outputs: all candidate catalogues, searchable local HTML, selected existing six-species PWM probability profiles, four-version synthetic partial-evaluation summaries, provenance and output SHA256
